scope: Smooth shared land-trade geometry for ground dirt paint, Trade highlights and symbolic cargo

implementation.geometry: Exact quadratic curves at unanchored degree-two nodes, split between incoming and outgoing edges
implementation.terrainSafety: Each half lies in its original traversed source cell; only habitable movement-neighbor edges enter the graph
implementation.anchors: Junctions, province centers, ports, surveyed building cells and local lane cells keep their exact connections
implementation.material: Procedural dirt paint batched by width, with soft shoulders and broken wear; no road mesh or new raster asset
implementation.alignment: Quadtree, relief ground paint and Trade highlights share exact curves; cargo uses sixteen samples per half-curve in either direction
implementation.simulation: Read-only presentation; routing, physical freight distances, costs, buildings and save schema unchanged

automated.command: node --import tsx --test tests/road-curves.test.ts tests/transport.test.ts tests/organic-growth.test.ts tests/relief.test.ts
coverage: Position and tangent continuity through bends, reversed travel and closed loops
Ground, overlay and cargo alignment with unchanged physical route distance and world state
Curves contained within traversable land cells beside mountains and water
Anchored junctions and building frontages, edge deduplication and cache invalidation
Shared strokes avoid repeated alpha caps
Existing transport, organic growth and relief contracts
automated.productionBuild: Passed TypeScript and Vite; existing bundle-size warning remains

browser.isolation: Dedicated fixture worker; no application saves or model calls

review.scope: Changed road presentation, five supplied captures and sampled source contracts
review.independentReviewer: Fresh generic sub-agent using the Impeccable finish-reviewer contract because the named role was unavailable
review.documenter: Independent generic documenter appended the surface refinement; DESIGN.md and global tokens remain unchanged
review.reviewLimit: Reviewer inspected captures and source; dynamic behavior and automated test results are builder-supplied evidence

boundaries: Sharp turns remain at physical frontage anchors and junctions; established buildings and lanes are not moved.
